0022600088.text: Both the Chicago Bulls and Toronto Raptors open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, with the Bulls on the road. The teams split no games in the 2026-27 season series yet, and Chicago lost all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 139-109 loss in Chicago on March 18. For the Bulls, Jordan Hawkins (illness) and Nic Claxton (hamstring) are out, Dailyn Swain is day-to-day with illness, and Isaac Okoro (knee), Leonard Miller (groin), Tobe Awaka (knee), and Zach Collins (toe, surgery) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. For Toronto, Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot) are out.
